schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agents" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'idle'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_configs" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "agent_id" TEXT,
  "agent_class" TEXT,
  "slot_id" TEXT,
  "config_data" JSON,
  "schema_version" INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_configs" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_smrt_agent_schedules" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "agent_type" TEXT,
  "agent_id" TEXT,
  "agent_config" TEXT,
  "cron" TEXT,
  "timezone" TEXT,
  "enabled" BOOLEAN,
  "status" TEXT,
  "last_run" TIMESTAMP,
  "next_run" TIMESTAMP,
  "last_status" TEXT,
  "last_error" TEXT,
  "run_count" INTEGER,
  "success_count" INTEGER,
  "failure_count" INTEGER,
  "max_concurrent" INTEGER,
  "running_count" INTEGER,
  "timeout" INTEGER,
  "method" TEXT,
  "method_args" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_smrt_agent_schedules" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenant_agents" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "agent_class" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT,
  "permissions" JSON,
  "config" JSON
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenant_agents" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);
